items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: If I did, I didn't know him.

ctx.x: So I couldn't say just where he was from. But I played with him, two engagements before he'd taken that ill-fated tour. And the Providence Hospital had some kind of benefit. And it was another club, it was a large club. And so he hired me for the two engagements. Well, he didn't ask me to make the trip, and I didn't want to go. I didn't ask him to go either, because I just figured he wasn't going to pay me the money I'd like to have. So when he was burned up in the fire and some of his men, naturally, when I was…
What about Johnny Torrio? Did you ever see him? Johnny Torrio?
If I did, I didn't know him. Yeah. You see what I'm talking about? Because in these places, it was known gangsters that frequented the places. They were there?
